artist.name: Dylan Conrique
artist.short_description: Dylan Conrique is an Afterglow discovery artist in the broader emotional-pop and songwriter catalogue.
artist.biography: Dylan Conrique is an American singer-songwriter and actress who has developed a catalogue of direct, emotionally communicative pop songs. Her breakout song 'Birthday Cake,' released in 2022, was written for a close friend whose mother had died. Conrique initially thought the story was too personal to release, but later discussed how the song connected with listeners facing their own losses. The same year included 'i miss you (skin to skin),' and her Pieces EP followed in 2023. In interviews she described challenging herself to write about other people's experiences and experimenting with narrative continuity across songs about breakups. Subsequent singles include 'last one to love me,' 'How To Lose The Girl,' 'Written In Stone' and 'A Little Like You.' Her work can connect Afterglow's heartbreak focus to a wider collection of stories about bereavement, friendship and starting again. The editorial distinction matters: 'Birthday Cake' has unusually specific first-person documentation, while the narratives behind many of her other songs still need separate sources before the site attributes an intention to her.
